content: For code, architecture, and reasoning tasks, a verified non-marketing tiered intelligence ranking of cost-effective LLMs is available: T1 (top capability, low to mid-low cost: DeepSeek V3/R1, Qwen2.5-Coder-72B, Yi-Lightning, Mistral Large 2), T2 (balanced speed/context: Qwen3-Coder-Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, etc.), T3 (low-cost fallback, near free: Nex AGI N2 Mini, Kwaipilot Kat-Coder Air V2.5, etc.), T4 (free, unstable, for lightweight testing only: OpenRouter free tier, FreeLLMAPI, Moddleman free pools).
